title: Welcome to Orbital Lab
intro: Explore three-dimensional orbits governed by Newtonian gravity.
world: Edit the central body's mass and radius, then apply.
orbit: Add spacecraft. Altitude and circular velocity are linked; applying resets that craft to a circular orbit.
maneuver: Preview a delta-v under Maneuver, then execute an instant impulse or finite ideal burn.
launch: Set vehicle and pitch-program parameters. A high apoapsis alone does not mean a stable orbit: periapsis must clear the surface.
save: Save named initial configurations to the local JSON file. Live flight state is not saved.
model: The central body is fixed and non-rotating. There is no atmosphere, mutual gravity, staging, or automatic orbit insertion. Custom 0° points along the local transverse direction of motion. Use Normal / Anti-normal for manual plane changes or Inclination to target a node impulse. Finite burns track local direction and do not consume fuel; launches do.
controls: Drag to rotate · Right-drag to pan · Scroll to zoom · Space to play/pause. All internal calculations use {{distanceUnit}}, {{massUnit}} and {{timeUnit}}.
